questions.questionText: The company announced ______ results. (possessivo — sem apóstrofo)
In 3.2, a consistent British version uses…

explanations.general: Correct answer: organisation, finalise, programme, centre

questions.questionText: In British style, “10 July 2026” doesn't need a comma.

content.text: Texto para editar (encontre e corrija pelo menos 10 erros):

Dear all, I'm writing to inform that the new software will be installed in the next monday. Everyone need to save their works before 6 pm. The IT team, will visit each departments to give some advices. It's important to note that the old system will stop working at 18:00; however the files will be saved automatically. If you have any doubt, please contact IT. The training session, which is optional will be on june 10, 2026 at 2 PM. Thank you for you're patience. Regards
usando grafia e formato britânicos, consistentes.

questions.questionText: Thank you for ______ patience. (possessivo de you)

The old system will stop however files will be saved.

explanations.general: Correct answer: The old system will stop; however, files will be saved.

questions.questionText: Consistency means using the same spelling and formats throughout a document.

content.text: 1 has · 2 for · 3 feedback · 4 its · 5 arrived in · 6 has worked in IT for three years · 7 sem vírgula · 8 more equipment.
finalize → finalise · program → programme · June 3 → 3 June · Programme (maiúscula sem motivo) → programme · 10 July, 2026 → 10 July 2026 · 2 PM → 14:00 ou 2 pm · moedas: padronizar £.

Dear all, I'm writing to inform you that the new software will be installed next Monday. Everyone needs to save their work before 18:00. The IT team will visit each department to give some advice. The old system will stop working at 18:00; however, files will be saved automatically. If you have any questions, please contact IT. The training session, which is optional, will be on 10 June 2026 at 14:00. Thank you for your patience. Kind regards,
